message:
Data-quality alert: the `customers` table now has two rows with the same email address, ana@example.com, even though new signups with an already-registered email are supposed to be rejected.

The timing lines up with a signed schema change that had just been approved and run against this table (changing the `tier` column's type to a wider numeric type). No application code was deployed between the schema change and the duplicate signup being accepted. Before that schema change, a duplicate signup with the same email had always been rejected in testing.
